output: Thanks for sharing the scale of your forecast, with about six thousand SKUs across thirty-two distribution points, and the four-minute recalculation you saw with your last tool is exactly the kind of slowdown that gets in the way of planning. You're right that very large models can slow down, and in our experience model design matters as much as the platform itself, so during implementation we review the model structure with your team to keep recalculation practical at your size. Before you commit to anything, we can also test performance on a sample of your own data. For a sense of what to expect, here is our [PLACEHOLDER] benchmark: recalculation time on a model sized like the prospect's. We would be glad to run a performance test on an anonymized sample of your largest model and share the results with you before any commitment.
